theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1_immersion_ball_isC1Submanifold
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (a : Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G a) → ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ IsC1Submanifold n (G '' ball a σ) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (G '' ball a σ) < ∞
